verses: I also saw the souls of several people whom they cause to weep; and they ever make piteous cries.
And I asked thus: 'Which people are these?'

Srosh the pious, and Adar the angel, said thus; 'These are the souls of those who had a father in their mother; and when they were born, the father did not acknowledge them; and now they ever make lamentation for a father.'
